extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policymakers, and general readers seeking country factbook data
extracted.subtask_description: Extract and standardize the country-profile fields and descriptive sections used in CIA-style factbook entries for small countries/territories (geography, people, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, transnational issues). Useful for building reference datasets or prompts for creative-writing worldbuilding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative historical background of the country or territory (colonial history, settlement, path to self-government/independence).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'First settled by the French in the early 17th century... ceded to the UK in 1814. Self-government was granted in 1967 and independence in 1979.' Typically summarizes major historical milestones and political transitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic location description (region, nearby seas/oceans, relative position to other countries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'Caribbean, island between the Caribbean Sea and North Atlantic Ocean, north of Trinidad and Tobago.' Useful for map/context placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Latitude and longitude coordinates of the country/territory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., '13 53 N, 60 68 W' — provided in degrees and minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Map references
rubrics_metrics.description: Map region references used for cartographic indexing (e.g., 'Central America and the Caribbean', 'North America').

rubrics_metrics.name: Area
rubrics_metrics.description: Total area and breakdown into land and water (sq km).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'total: 616 sq km; water: 10 sq km; land: 606 sq km'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area - comparative
rubrics_metrics.description: Comparative statement placing the country's area relative to a well-known entity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., '3.5 times the size of Washington, DC'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of land borders in kilometers (if any).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., '0 km' for island states.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coastline
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of coastline (km).

rubrics_metrics.name: Maritime claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims such as territorial sea, contiguous zone, exclusive economic zone, continental shelf extents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'territorial sea: 12 nm; continental shelf: 200 nm or to the edge of the continental margin; exclusive economic zone: 200 nm'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate
rubrics_metrics.description: General climate description and seasonal patterns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'tropical, moderated by northeast trade winds; dry season from January to April, rainy season from May to August' or 'cold and wet, with much mist and fog'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terrain
rubrics_metrics.description: Physical terrain summary (volcanic, mountainous, mostly barren rock, fertile valleys, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevation extremes
rubrics_metrics.description: Lowest and highest elevation points (with values and place names).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'lowest point: Caribbean Sea 0 m; highest point: Mount Gimie 950 m'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural resources
rubrics_metrics.description: List of notable natural resources (forests, beaches, minerals, fish, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Land use
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent breakdown of land use categories (arable, permanent crops, other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'arable land: 6.56%; permanent crops: 22.95%; other: 70.49% (2001)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Irrigated land
rubrics_metrics.description: Area of irrigated land (sq km) with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural hazards
rubrics_metrics.description: Notable natural hazards faced by the country (hurricanes, volcanic activity, fog/maritime hazards).

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - current issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Environmental problems or concerns (deforestation, soil erosion, coastal pollution, test drilling impacts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'deforestation; soil erosion, particularly in the northern region' or 'pollution of coastal waters and shorelines from discharges by pleasure yachts'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - international agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Treaties and international environmental agreements to which the country is a party or has signed but not ratified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'party to: Biodiversity, Climate Change, Climate Change-Kyoto Protocol, Desertification, Endangered Species, ... signed, but not ratified: none of the selected agreements'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - note
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional notable geographic or scenic features called out separately (tourist attractions, unique landforms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'the twin Pitons... are one of the scenic natural highlights of the Caribbean'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population (total)
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated total population and the dating of the estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Population distribution by age groups with counts or percentages (0-14, 15-64, 65+), sometimes separated by sex.

rubrics_metrics.name: Median age
rubrics_metrics.description: Median age overall and by sex, with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual population growth rate (percentage) with estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Birth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Births per 1,000 population (estimate year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Death rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Deaths per 1,000 population (estimate year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Net migration rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Net migration per 1,000 population (estimate year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sex ratio
rubrics_metrics.description: Sex ratios at birth, under 15, 15-64, 65+, and total population.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infant mortality rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births (total and sometimes by sex) with estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Life expectancy at birth
rubrics_metrics.description: Life expectancy (total and by sex) with estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fertility rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Average number of children born per woman (estimate year).

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Adult prevalence rate, people living with HIV/AIDS, and deaths (when provided) or 'NA' if not available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationality (noun/adjective)
rubrics_metrics.description: Names for nationals and adjectival form used to describe citizens.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethnic groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Ethnic composition percentages (e.g., black, mixed, East Indian, white).

rubrics_metrics.name: Religions
rubrics_metrics.description: Religious affiliation breakdown (percentages by denomination).

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Official and commonly spoken languages (e.g., English, French patois).

rubrics_metrics.name: Literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition used for literacy and percent literate by sex and total (with year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'definition: age 15 and over has ever attended school; total population: 67%' or 'definition: age 15 and over can read and write'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Country name (conventional forms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventional long and short forms of the country's name and any local names.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dependency status
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the territory is independent, self-governing, or a dependency/collectivity and notes about sovereignty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government type
rubrics_metrics.description: Form of government (Westminster-style parliamentary democracy, parliamentary democracy, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital
rubrics_metrics.description: Capital city name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary first-order administrative subdivisions and examples/listing of names.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence
rubrics_metrics.description: Date of independence (if applicable) and from whom.

rubrics_metrics.name: National holiday
rubrics_metrics.description: Date and description of national holiday (e.g., Independence Day).

rubrics_metrics.name: Constitution
rubrics_metrics.description: Date or reference to constitution adoption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal system
rubrics_metrics.description: Basis of the legal system (English common law, French law, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Suffrage
rubrics_metrics.description: Voting age and whether suffrage is universal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive branch details
rubrics_metrics.description: Chief of state, head of government, key officeholders, appointment and election notes, cabinet selection process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'chief of state: Queen ELIZABETH II ... represented by Governor General ... head of government: Prime Minister Kenneth Davis ANTHONY (since 24 May 1997)'

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative branch details
rubrics_metrics.description: Structure (unicameral/bicameral), number of seats, selection/appointment rules, term lengths, recent election results and dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'bicameral Parliament consists of the Senate (11 seats) and the House of Assembly (17 seats); members are elected by popular vote from single-member constituencies to serve five-year terms'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Name and jurisdiction of the judicial authority (e.g., Eastern Caribbean Supreme Court).

rubrics_metrics.name: Political parties and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: List of main political parties and named leaders (when provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Political pressure groups and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Noted pressure groups and their leaders, or 'NA' when none listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international organizations the country participates in (UN agencies, regional banks, trade groups).

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation in the US
rubrics_metrics.description: Chief of mission, chancery address, telephone and fax numbers, consulates in US cities (if any).

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation from the US
rubrics_metrics.description: US diplomatic representation arrangements (embassy presence or accreditation via another country).

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: Heraldic or visual description of the national flag.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'blue, with a gold isosceles triangle below a black arrowhead; the upper edges of the arrowhead have a white border'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative overview of the economy, major sectors, vulnerabilities, and recent developments (tourism, agriculture, offshore banking, subsidies, diversification).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Often mentions shocks (e.g., 9/11 tourism decline), government finances, and major projects (e.g., new hotel openings).

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP (purchasing power parity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total GDP using PPP with the estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - real growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Real GDP growth rate percentage with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - per capita (PPP)
rubrics_metrics.description: GDP per capita using purchasing power parity with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - composition by sector
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent share of GDP by agriculture, industry, and services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population below poverty line
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent or note 'NA' when not available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Household income or consumption by percentage share
rubrics_metrics.description: Income share for lowest and highest deciles (often NA).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inflation rate (consumer prices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consumer price inflation rate with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force (total)
rubrics_metrics.description: Size of the labor force with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force - by occupation
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution of labor force across sectors or occupations (percent or descriptions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Unemployment rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Unemployment percentage with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget - revenues and expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Government budget figures with revenues, expenditures, and capital expenditures and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture - products
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary agricultural products produced in the country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industries
rubrics_metrics.description: Key industrial sectors and manufactured goods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial production growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Growth rate of industrial production with year (often NA).

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity - production/consumption/exports/imports
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual electricity production and consumption figures (kWh) and exports/imports with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil - production/consumption/exports/imports
rubrics_metrics.description: Oil figures (barrels per day) and export/import status with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports (total)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total export value with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - commodities
rubrics_metrics.description: Major export commodities and their shares when given (e.g., bananas 41%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary export destination countries and percentages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports (total)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total import value with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports - commodities
rubrics_metrics.description: Major import commodities and percentage breakdowns when given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports - partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary countries supplying imports and percentages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debt - external
rubrics_metrics.description: External debt figure (USD) with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic aid - recipient
rubrics_metrics.description: Amount of economic aid received or noted recipients/grants with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency and currency code
rubrics_metrics.description: Official currency name and ISO code (e.g., East Caribbean dollar (XCD), euro (EUR)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Exchange rate listing (local currency per US dollar) over recent years or specific year values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiscal year period (calendar year or specific dates like 1 April - 31 March).

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications - telephones (main lines)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of main telephone lines in use with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications - mobile cellular
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of mobile cellular subscriptions/users with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Telephone system
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment and description of domestic and international telephone infrastructure and connections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., 'general assessment: good interisland and international connections; domestic: inter-island links ... handled by VHF/UHF/SHF radiotelephone'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Radio broadcast stations
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of AM, FM, shortwave radio broadcast stations with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Radios (number)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of radio receivers in the country (with year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Television broadcast stations
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of television broadcast stations and repeaters (with year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Televisions (number)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of television sets in the country (with year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet country code
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level country code domain (e.g., .lc, .kn, .pm, .vc).

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet hosts
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of internet hosts registered (with year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet Service Providers (ISPs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of ISPs operating (with year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet users
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number of internet users (with year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - railways
rubrics_metrics.description: Railway totals and gauge information (if present), with notes on usage (e.g., sugarcane harvest railways).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - highways
rubrics_metrics.description: Total highway length and paved vs unpaved breakdown (with year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ports and harbors
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary ports and harbors serving the country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merchant marine
rubrics_metrics.description: Existence/size of merchant marine ('none' if absent).

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports (total)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of airports (with year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports - with paved runways
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of airports by runway length categories (e.g., 1,524 to 2,437 m).

rubrics_metrics.name: Military branches
rubrics_metrics.description: Names and components of defense and police forces (e.g., Defense Force, Royal Police Force, Coast Guard).

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - military age and obligation
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum military age and notes on obligation (if listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Military expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Military spending figures (dollar figure or percent of GDP) or 'NA' if not available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational Issues - disputes (international)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes on international disputes and multilateral positions (e.g., participation in counterclaims to Venezuela).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational Issues - illicit drugs
rubrics_metrics.description: Role in drug transshipment, narcotics production, money-laundering concerns, and trafficking notes.
